title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Bellarmine University
description: When the library closes or the game ends, Bellarmine students head to these reliable late-night spots in the Highlands and along Bardstown Road for fuel and community.

cards.title: Palio
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Late Knight Dining
cards.notes: Order via touch-screen kiosks for fresh meals. This high-tech venue accepts Late Knight meal swipes for students staying on campus after hours.
cards.short_summary: A technology-focused on-campus dining venue offering digital ordering and late-night meal options for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Palio features Food on Demand (FoD) and accepts Late Knight Meal Swipes, Flex Dollars, cash, and credit cards.
cards.access_notes: Located in the University Center; check seasonal schedules for specific Late Knight service hours.

cards.title: Spinelli's Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: Highlands Pizza Staple
cards.notes: Grab a massive slice of Philly-style pizza at this eclectic Highlands spot. It is a go-to for students due to its proximity and 5 AM closing time.
cards.short_summary: A late-night pizzeria in the Highlands known for its Philadelphia-style slices and late operating hours until 5 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: The Highlands location at 614 Baxter Ave is open for dine-in and delivery from 11 AM to 5 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Open until 5:00 AM daily for late-night dining and carry-out.

cards.title: La Bamba
cards.subtitle: Burritos as Big as Your Head
cards.notes: Famous for oversized burritos, this Bardstown Road favorite serves the student crowd well into the early morning hours.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican restaurant on Bardstown Road popular for its large burritos and late-night availability.
cards.evidence_claim: The Louisville location at 1237 Bardstown Rd is open until 3:00 AM for pickup.
cards.access_notes: Open until 3:00 AM daily for pickup orders.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Sweet Treats
cards.notes: Perfect for late-night study sessions, this bakery delivers warm cookies to campus until 3 AM on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A bakery specializing in warm cookie delivery and walk-in service late into the night.
cards.evidence_claim: The Highlands location is open until 1 AM Sunday-Wednesday and 3 AM Thursday-Saturday.
cards.source_title: Find an Insomnia Cookies Location Near You
cards.access_notes: Retail store open until 3:00 AM on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday nights.

cards.title: Jeff's Donuts
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Donut Destination
cards.notes: Located just a short drive from campus, this shop offers over 40 varieties of donuts at any hour of the day or night.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour donut shop providing a wide selection of fresh pastries and coffee at all times.
cards.evidence_claim: The St. Matthews location at 6401 New Dutchmans Pkwy is open daily 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

cards.title: Raising Cane's
cards.subtitle: Post-Game Chicken Fingers
cards.notes: A popular stop for chicken finger meals after Bellarmine athletic events, with the drive-thru serving late into the night.
cards.short_summary: A fast-food restaurant specializing in chicken fingers, located on the Bardstown Road corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The location at 1250 Bardstown Road is open until 1:00 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 AM for late-night cravings.

cards.title: QDOBA Mexican Eats
cards.subtitle: Midnight Burrito Bowls
cards.notes: Conveniently located at the intersection of Bardstown and Eastern Parkway, this spot is a reliable late-night option for customizable bowls.
cards.short_summary: A fast-casual Mexican restaurant offering burritos and tacos with late-night hours on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: The 1500 Bardstown Rd location is open until 12:00 AM on Wednesday and Thursday nights.
cards.source_title: QDOBA in Louisville, KY on 1500 Bardstown Rd
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM on select nights; check current hours for weekend extensions.

cards.title: Waffle House
cards.subtitle: The 24-Hour Classic
cards.notes: The ultimate 24-hour fallback for breakfast food. It's a reliable destination for students when everything else is closed.
cards.short_summary: An iconic 24-hour diner serving American breakfast and comfort food at all times.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House #1444 at 7715 Bardstown Rd is open 24 hours daily.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Drive-Thru
cards.notes: A staple for quick, inexpensive late-night food. The drive-thru on Bardstown Road is a frequent stop for students heading back to campus.
cards.short_summary: A fast-food chain known for its late-night drive-thru service and Mexican-inspired menu.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 1069 Bardstown Rd serves the Highlands area with late-night hours.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Louisville, KY - 1069 Bardstown Rd
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru typically remains open later than the dining room; check local signage for exact closing times.

cards.title: Burger Girl Diner
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Neighborhood Diner
cards.notes: A local favorite for late-night burgers and breakfast. This 24/7 diner provides a classic atmosphere for late-night conversations.
cards.short_summary: A traditional 24-hour diner in Louisville offering a full menu of comfort food at any hour.
cards.evidence_claim: Burger Girl Diner is noted as being open 24/7 for those with midnight munchies.
cards.source_title: Where to find late-night food in Louisville
